verdict.rationale: Zapier is a workflow automation product, so reusable sub-workflows are a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence documents sub-Zaps, callable modules, or workflows invoking other workflows. Stored actions (zapier-docs-29) are single saved API actions run by ID, and tool bundles (zapier-docs-30) share MCP tool lists; neither is a reusable sub-workflow that other workflows call.
